information_for_contributors: Grammar for the DDL (Defeasible Deontic Logic) language used by the `deontic` reasoner.
Each construct lives in its own named rule in `repository` with a `comment` describing it.
ORDER MATTERS: the top-level `patterns` list is tried left-to-right at each position.
Keep these rules in sync with Deontic/Parser.lean. After editing, open
`samples/showcase.ddl` (which exercises every token) and check the colours,
or run the scope inspector: Ctrl+Shift+P -> 'Developer: Inspect Editor Tokens and Scopes'.
Token -> scope map is documented in README.md ('Maintaining the grammar').
name: DDL

line-selector.comment: GitHub-style line selector in a provenance uri, e.g. file.md#L3-L5. Must precede #comment.
line-selector.name: constant.numeric.line-selector.ddl

comment.comment: Line comment from # to end of line.
comment.name: comment.line.number-sign.ddl

sections.comment: Top-level sections that introduce facts or the superiority relation.

atom-decl.comment: Atom declaration `atom NAME: ...` — keyword plus the declared atom name.

rule-label.comment: A rule label at line start, before its `:` (sections/atoms are matched earlier).

provenance-keys.comment: Provenance field keys inside an atom declaration.
provenance-keys.name: keyword.other.provenance.ddl

arrows.comment: Rule arrows: strict ->/->O, defeasible =>/=>O, defeater ~>/~>O (longest first).
arrows.name: keyword.operator.arrow.ddl

deontic.comment: Deontic operators applied to a literal: O() F() P() Pw() Ps() C(). Longest first.
deontic.name: support.function.deontic.ddl

punctuation.comment: The provenance separator between description and provenance segments.
punctuation.name: punctuation.separator.provenance.ddl
